title: A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Uniqueness of Euclidean Division
summary: A well-known result from the 1960s characterizes all Euclidean domains in which division is guaranteed to produce a unique quotient and remainder. As this relies on the historical (and more restrictive) definition of a Euclidean domain, the question of whether the result still holds under the modern definition was left open. In this paper, we prove the answer is afirmative.
